name: Read supporting document
description: Optional, read-only action for inspecting one previously uploaded and confirmed supporting file from this interview. The file name is resolved inside the server-owned Supporting documents folder for the caller's current or resumable completed interview; it cannot read other folders or arbitrary files.

inputFields.label: Supporting file name
inputFields.description: The exact basename, including extension, of a previously uploaded and confirmed supporting file in this interview (for example, Process-Checklist.pdf). Do not provide a path or URL.
